text:
hannah: kicking off rollout plan for 'Slate' routing experiment (split routing to quantized-fast backend + graceful fallbacks). goal: get predictable perf wins without surprise quality regressions. proposing mixed tenant + regional approach with automated rollback hooks.

lee: +1. prefer per-region micro-canaries to catch infra differences early. recommend us-west1 + eu-central initially.

priya: telemetry gates needed up-front. propose these primary signals: p99 latency delta, overall 5xx rate, eval-set quality delta, and token-cost delta. also add synthetic throughput test to validate tail latencies under burst.

hannah: suggested rollout steps (weights): 0.25% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Each step waits for 2 evaluation windows (5m windows) and a quality check (synthetic prompts) before proceeding.

jasper: customer strategy: seed with 10 enterprise tenants (manual opt-in) for 48h. then start micro-canaries on random small-tenants. big tenants get tenant-level opt-out and pre-notice.

lee: automation rules: feature-flag `slate_route_v1` with per-region weights and tenant override. implement auto-decrease: if any gate breaches for 2 consecutive windows, reduce weight 2x or rollback to prior weight if at first step. add immediate circuit-breaker to route matching traffic to stable pool on critical failures.

ops-bot: deploy window notice: scheduled Slate rollout pending runbook link. Deploy locked until runbook posted.

priya: concrete gate thresholds (initial probe):
```
- p99 latency increase <= 20ms absolute
- 5xx spike <= +0.3% absolute
- quality regression (eval A/B) >= -0.4% absolute
- token-cost increase <= +10% relative
```
These are soft for probes; tighten by ~50% for broader ramp.

hannah: fallback priority (explicit routing order): 1) quantized-fast variant, 2) stable checkpoint pinned, 3) regional Dedicated pool, 4) global Dedicated overflow. Need routing rule to specify monotonic priority.

jasper: ops & customer comms checklist: pre-roll email to seeded tenants, opt-in form + SLA note, rollback contact, public incident channel. I'll own customer comms.

lee: infra checklist: autoscale buffer for Dedicated fallback pools set to +30%, circuit-breaker hook, trace sampling for affected requests, and a throttling policy if token-cost delta > +12% for 1h.

priya: quality checklist: include edge-case prompts (long-context math, code completion with strange tokens) in the synthetic suite. add a small human review sample for enterprise tenants at 1% of their routed requests.

hannah: decision: proceed with tenant-seed + regional micro-canaries. owners: hannah (product), lee (infra/routing), priya (quality), jasper (customer comms). I'll raise the feature-flag PR with runbook link and a checklist. tagging follow-ups as GH issues.

ops-bot: deploy window remains locked until runbook link present. Use `/deploy unlock` once added.
